answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 36420 Country: India Title: I got married last year. We did not go for a child as we wanted to do Hajj this year but we could not do the Hajj for some reason Question: I got married last year. We did not go for a child as we wanted to do Hajj this year but we could not do the Hajj for some reason. Now it is possible in-sha-Allah that I may go for Ph.D. abroad soon. My question is whether should we plan for a child now before going abroad or should we plan for a child after going abroad? Also is it a sin to delay going for a child? Answer ID: 36420 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! I got married last year. We did not go for a child as we wanted to do Hajj this year but we could not do the Hajj for some reason. Now it is possible in-sha-Allah that I may go for Ph.D. abroad soon. My question is whether should we plan for a child now before going abroad or should we plan for a child after going abroad? Also is it a sin to delay going for a child? Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
